name: AppFlowy
summary: Open-source AI workspace for wikis, projects and notes, with a free Personal cloud plan and a paid Pro plan, plus a self-hosted option.
description: Open-source AI workspace for wikis, projects and notes, with a free Personal cloud plan and a paid Pro plan, plus a self-hosted option.

pricing.details: Cloud: Personal 0 €/month — 1 workspace owner, up to 100 MB storage, file uploads up to 7 MB, 7-day version history, 1 form and 1 chart; AI meeting notes, AI transcript, AI responses and AI search are a limited trial on Personal. Pro 11 €/member/month billed annually (130 €/member/year), or 14 €/member/month billed monthly (official “Save 25%” on yearly) — unlimited members charged per member, guest editors free of charge, unlimited storage and file uploads, 90-day version history, unlimited forms and charts, custom team spaces and permission groups, Local AI, publish pages, custom namespace, PDF export including subpages, and AppFlowy AI beyond the Personal trial. Official examples: a Pro workspace with only you is 11 €/month billed annually (130 €/year) or 14 € billed monthly; with five members, 54 €/month billed annually (651 €/year) or 72 € billed monthly. Each workspace is tied to a plan; several Personal and Pro workspaces can run at the same time and are billed separately. Self-hosting is offered on the same official pricing page;
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Open-source AI workspace for wikis, projects and notes, with official Cloud and self-hosted options
Personal is a lasting 0 € plan; AppFlowy AI is only a limited trial on that plan
Pro unlocks AI beyond the trial, unlimited storage and members, at 11 €/member/month billed annually or 14 € billed monthly
Self-hosted deployment options are described on the official pricing page.
